items.docs: Returns a list of all knowledge bases associated with the authenticated user's account, including their name, document count, and processing status.

Creates a new knowledge base for storing and retrieving enterprise documents. The knowledge base serves as a container for documents that will be chunked, embedded, and indexed for retrieval-augmented generation queries.
